Lemma
[Evolution of the Euclidean invariant] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0145, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0146 1. ch29:29.48\group The $Q$ Invariant

For $\overline Q=\overline v|\overline a|^2$ on $\mathbb R^2$, the evolution is the nonpositive heat-type identity (29.196). In particular, $\overline Q$ is a subsolution of the Euclidean pressure heat operator.
